assertions.subject: Metastasis
assertions.quote: N0: No regional lymph node metastasis

assertions.subject: Metastasis
assertions.predicate: tumor in 1 to 3 regional lymph nodes
assertions.quote: N1: 1 to 3 regional lymph nodes are positive

assertions.subject: Metastasis
assertions.predicate: tumor deposits in subserosa, mesentery, nonperitonealized pericolic, or perirectal or mesorectal tissues
assertions.quote: N1c: No regional lymph nodes are positive, but tumor deposits are present

assertions.subject: Metastasis
assertions.predicate: 4 or more regional lymph nodes are positive
assertions.quote: N2: 4 or more regional lymph nodes are positive

assertions.subject: Metastasis
assertions.quote: M0: No distant metastasis by imaging; no evidence of tumor in distant sites or organs

assertions.subject: Metastasis
assertions.predicate: metastasis to 1 or more distant sites or organs
assertions.quote: M1: Metastasis to 1 or more distant sites or organs or peritoneal metastasis is identified
